details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4112-4120 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: pre_rebuild_branch_head_sha always records final_pr_head_sha instead of the integration branch head immediately before deletion.
  WHY: The audit snapshot is supposed to capture pre-rebuild state, but this field permanently points at the PR head SHA, so recovery and post-mortem logic cannot reconstruct what was actually on the branch.
- ai-memory/schemas/branch_rebuild_audit.v1.json + scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:required array (branch_protected, failure_detail, completed_at) and put_branch_rebuild_audit / validate_branch_rebuild_audit_payload | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The audit schema/validation path is reported as requiring fields that some builder paths can null out or omit.
  WHY: Four reviewers flagged this as a validation break that would make persisted audits unreadable, while two other reviewers explicitly rechecked the schema and rejected the concern because nullable fields are allowed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4175-4250 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: now_ts and related epoch values are used in arithmetic without validating that the command output is numeric.
  WHY: Empty or malformed output can trigger integer-expression errors and misclassify the rebuild gate or cooldown decision.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4488-4489 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: parent_count from awk is compared arithmetically without numeric validation.
  WHY: Empty or non-numeric output can trigger integer-expression errors and mask the real replay failure behind generic exit handling.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_branch_rebuild_audit_path, put_branch_rebuild_audit | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: sanitize_segment(..., "branch") lower-casing can make the stored audit path key diverge from the lookup key for mixed-case branches.
  WHY: A mixed-case branch name can miss the cached audit entry and bypass cooldown/threshold gates stored under a differently normalized key.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4394-4540 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The destructive delete/recreate/replay sequence has no distributed lock or idempotency guard.
  WHY: Concurrent pollers can race branch deletion and audit writes, leaving the integration branch in an inconsistent state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4464-4505 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The replay loop stops at the first failed commit and never processes the remaining commits.
  WHY: Operators lose full replay-order evidence and cannot tell whether earlier commits succeeded or which commit actually failed first.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4464-4540 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Replay failure leaves the recreated branch partially replayed because there is no rollback of the branch/ref mutation.
  WHY: The branch remains in a half-replayed state, so subsequent polls can observe stale escalated state and partial rebuild side effects.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7830-7960 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` doc comment is stale relative to the fields now returned by the implementation.
  WHY: The documented linked_pr shape omits merged_at and merge_commit_sha, which can mislead consumers of the cached JSON contract.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "add focused tests for threshold handling, cooldown enforcement, audit round-trip, and replay-failure behavior"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_branch_rebuild.py exists and contains audit round-trip coverage, but grepping the CI workflow allowlists returns zero matches for test_branch_rebuild.py, so those new tests will not run in CI.
- requirement: "snapshot pre-rebuild state"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh inside _attempt_branch_rebuild_after_escalation before branch delete
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk captures the actual integration-branch HEAD SHA before the DELETE ref call; pre_rebuild_branch_head_sha is copied from final_pr_head_sha in every _build_branch_rebuild_audit_json call.
- requirement: "keep branch rebuild audits schema-compatible and readable on subsequent reads"
  expected_change_site: ai-memory/schemas/branch_rebuild_audit.v1.json, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  EVIDENCE: The review claims the schema requires branch_protected, failure_detail, and completed_at while builder paths can emit null or omit fields, so later reads would fail validation.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4112-4120 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: pre_rebuild_branch_head_sha is set from final_pr_head_sha instead of the actual integration branch head before deletion.
  WHY: The audit record permanently documents the wrong reference point for pre-rebuild state, so downstream recovery cannot reconstruct what was actually on the branch.
- Requirement: "add focused tests for threshold handling, cooldown enforcement, audit round-trip, and replay-failure behavior" (Issue #2860, scope bullet 4)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, or .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, or .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml — the CI test execution allowlists
  Evidence of absence: tests/test_branch_rebuild.py exists in the PR and contains test_branch_rebuild_audit_round_trip and test_branch_rebuild_audit_rejects_schema_mismatch (audit round-trip coverage). Grep for test_branch_rebuild across ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, and test-and-mark-stable.yml returns zero matches. The file is not invoked by any CI job. The threshold, cooldown, and replay-failure tests live in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py and do run in CI, but the audit-round-trip unit tests in test_branch_rebuild.py will never execute. The issue required all four categories of focused tests; audit round-trip coverage exists on disk but is invisible to CI.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
(No findings reported.)

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4231-4250 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Integer arithmetic uses now_ts and related epoch values without validating they parsed as strictly numeric strings.
  WHY: A shell arithmetic expansion on non-numeric strings triggers “integer expression expected” and can misclassify the rebuild gate or cooldown checks.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4488-4489 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: parent_count derived via awk '{print NF - 1}' is used in integer comparison without validating the result is numeric.
  WHY: Empty or non-numeric output causes “integer expression expected”, falls through to the cherry-pick branch, and masks the real cause behind generic exit code 23 handling.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4112-4113 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: pre_rebuild_branch_head_sha is unconditionally set to final_pr_head_sha instead of the actual integration branch HEAD SHA.
  WHY: The audit record permanently documents the wrong pre-rebuild state, so recovery and post-mortem analysis cannot reconstruct what was actually on the branch.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_branch_rebuild_audit_path, put_branch_rebuild_audit | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: sanitize_segment(..., "branch") lower-casing can make the on-disk path key inconsistent with the lookup key.
  WHY: Mixed-case branch names can miss the stored audit entry or bypass cooldown/threshold gates under a differently normalized key.
- ai-memory/schemas/branch_rebuild_audit.v1.json | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Schema declares branch_protected, failure_detail, and completed_at as required but the builder can emit null or omit them on some paths.
  WHY: Validation failures on subsequent reads can make audit documents unreadable and break rebuild retries.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_attempt_branch_rebuild_after_escalation entire block and success-following jq updates | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No distributed lock or idempotency guard protects the destructive rebuild sequence and audit writes.
  WHY: Concurrent rebuilds can race branch deletion/recreation and leave the integration branch or audit state inconsistent.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4488-4489 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `parent_count` variable from awk is used in arithmetic comparison without numeric validation
  WHY: If `parent_line` is empty or awk produces no output, `parent_count` will be empty, causing `[ "${parent_count}" -gt 1 ]` to fail with "integer expression expected" error, masking the real failure behind exit code 23
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4175-4183 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `now_ts` from `date -u +%s` is used in arithmetic without validation
  WHY: If the date command fails or produces unexpected output, the arithmetic `$(( now_ts - escalated_ts ))` will fail with "integer expression expected", causing the threshold check to error out instead of gracefully skipping
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4112, 4375, 4392 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `pre_rebuild_branch_head_sha` is set to `final_pr_head_sha` instead of the actual integration branch HEAD SHA
  WHY: The audit record is supposed to snapshot pre-rebuild state, but it records the PR head SHA instead of
